tagline: Direct messages between the people who use your mvmOS.
description:
mvmOS Chat is one-to-one messaging between Apps Hub accounts. Find someone by name, start a conversation, and it stays in your list. Contacts come from your Apps Hub favourites, so the people you talk to most are always at the top.

Messages arrive live over a WebSocket, with typing indicators, editing and deleting — either just for you, or for everyone. The same conversations are reachable from a public web page for your Apps Hub account and from a Telegram mini-app, so you can keep talking away from the desktop.
capabilities: One-to-one conversations between Apps Hub accounts.
Live delivery over a WebSocket, with typing indicators.
Search for people, and a contacts list built from your Apps Hub favourites.
Edit a sent message, marked as edited.
Delete a message for yourself or for everyone.
Public web page for your Apps Hub account and a Telegram mini-app.

integrations.name: Telegram Hub
integrations.summary: Chat ships a Telegram adapter, so your conversations are reachable from the Telegram Hub bot.
integrations.requires: Telegram Hub installed with a bot token configured, and your Telegram account linked to your Apps Hub account.
